package rulefixtures

import (
	"database/sql"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for sql_null_types_escape_repository_boundary: Repository methods that leak driver-specific null wrappers beyond the persistence boundary.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserRepo struct {
	db *sql.DB
}

type UserRow struct {
	ID     int
	Name   sql.NullString
	Bio    sql.NullString
	Avatar sql.NullString
}

func (r *UserRepo) FindByID(id int) (*UserRow, error) {
	row := &UserRow{}
	err := r.db.QueryRow(`SELECT id, name, bio, avatar FROM users WHERE id = $1`, id).
		Scan(&row.ID, &row.Name, &row.Bio, &row.Avatar)
	return row, err
}

func GetUserHandler(c *gin.Context, repo *UserRepo) {
	user, err := repo.FindByID(1)
	if err != nil {
		c.JSON(500, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(200, gin.H{
		"id":   user.ID,
		"name": user.Name,
		"bio":  user.Bio,
	})
}
